cohort: 3,963 women (2,090 nulliparae and 1,873 multiparae) with a singleton pregnancy in cephalic presentation
finding: Applying amniotomy, oxytocin, and neuraxial analgesia at their optimal timing may improve the progress and outcome of labor.
mod_finding: The study found that neuraxial analgesia administered later in labor was associated with a lower likelihood of spontaneous birth and a higher likelihood of operative vaginal birth or cesarean section.
